params.name: page
params.description: The page of the results which was returned.

params.name: page_size
params.description: How many results are in each page.

params.name: fields
params.description:
Comma separated list of fields within the location object to return. Can be used to greatly reduce the size of the response by requesting only data you intend to use.
Cannot be used in tandem with `_excl_fields`

params.name: _excl_fields
params.description: Comma separated list of fields within the location object to exclude from the response. Can be used to greatly reduce the size of the response by requesting only data you intend to use.

params.name: address
params.description: String input of an address that will be interpreted and geocoded in real time.

params.name: name
params.description: String input for a 'fuzzy' search on location name.

params.name: distance
params.description: The proximity radius of locations returned.

params.name: location_types
params.description:
Comma separated list of values that filter to what type of facilities to show. We categorize locations into 36 types. Clients can add their own locations with unique location_types, and they will also be included in the search.
See the Location Types Reference Endpoint for a list of all location types.

params.name: _excl_location_types
params.description: Comma separated list of the 'types' of locations to exclude. Excludes locations with a matching location type.

params.name: location
params.description: Latitude/longitude pair of coordinates in lieu of a string address.

params.name: location_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of desired practice location uuids.

params.name: _excl_location_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of practice location uuids to exclude.

params.name: insurance_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of desired insurance uuids. See all locations that accept a given insurance(s).

params.name: _excl_insurance_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of insurance uuids to exclude. Exclude locations that accept a given insurance(s).

params.name: insurance_carrier_name
params.description:
String input of carrier_name in order to search for all locations that take at least one plan from a given insurance carrier.
Find the individual valid carrier_name values from the insurance objects returned in the Insurances Reference Endpoint.
Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: min_confidence
params.description: Integer input (0-5) of the minimum confidence threshold for returned locations. min_location_confidence=4 will only display locations that have a confidence 4 or higher.

params.name: national_bluecard
params.description: Boolean input that enables an API search to automatically default to the National BlueCard EPO/PPO Network whenever a member searches for out-of-state, in-network care and is covered by a BCBS Association PPO insurance plan. Use the parameter in conjunction with the address parameter and either the insurance_ids or insurance fuzzy search parameters. Defaults to true unless otherwise specified.

params.name: organization_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of desired organization uuids. Filters to only locations that are affiliated with the given organization uuid(s).

params.name: _excl_organization_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of organization uuids to exclude. Excludes locations that are affiliated with the given organization uuid(s).

params.name: clinical_area
params.description:
String input that is fuzzy matched to the most relevant `clinical_area.display` field. Only a single clinical area will be selected.
Returns all location with this clinical area.

params.name: clinical_area_ids
params.description:
Comma-separated list of desired clinical area ids.
Returns all locations with a clinical area exactly matching any of the entered IDs.
(Note: Use the `/clinical_areas/` reference endpoint to identify relevant IDs)

params.name: _excl_clinical_area_ids
params.description:
Comma-separated list of clinical area ids to exclude.
Returns all locations without a clinical area exactly matching any of the entered IDs.
(Note: Use the `/clinical_areas/` reference endpoint to identify relevant IDs)

params.name: treatment
params.description:
String input that is fuzzy matched to the most relevant `treatments.display` field. Only a single treatment will be selected.
Returns all locations with this treatment.

params.name: treatment_ids
params.description:
Comma-separated list of desired treatment ids.
Returns all locations with a `treatments.uuid` field exactly matching any of the entered IDs.
(Note: Use the /treatments/ reference endpoint (docs) to identify relevant IDs)

params.name: _excl_treatment_ids
params.description:
Comma-separated list of treatment ids to exclude.
Returns all locations without a `treatments.uuid` field exactly matching any of the entered IDs.
(Note: Use the /treatments/ reference endpoint (docs) to identify relevant IDs)

params.name: tin_ids
params.description:
Comma separated list of desired TINs. Filters to only locations that are affiliated with the given TINs.
Note: This parameter cannot be used in combination with any other TINs related parameters. All other TINs related parameters will be ignored.

params.name: tin_name
params.description: String input that is fuzzy matched against the `tins.name` field. Filters to only locations that are affiliated with the given TINs name.

params.name: tin_legal_name
params.description: String input that is fuzzy matched against the `tins.legal_name` field. Filters to only locations that are affiliated with the given TINs legal name.
